achievements.label: Short-sighted Decision
achievements.descriptionLocked: “General, your tank is a sturdy vehicle.” — Bertolt Brecht
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: “General, your tank is a sturdy vehicle.” — Bertolt Brecht
achievements.unlockMessage: “General, your tank is a sturdy vehicle.” — Bertolt Brecht [You occupied the strange church, and indeed there were no more cries at midnight.]

achievements.label: Fate Has Run Its Course
achievements.descriptionLocked: “The traveler never stops walking. The door stands long.”
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: “The traveler never stops walking. The door stands long.”
achievements.unlockMessage: “The traveler never stops walking. The door stands long.” [Bring the weeping maiden to the destined place and leave her there.]

achievements.label: Little Sister Cannot Speak of Love
achievements.descriptionLocked: “Like a lamp I twist off, when I don't want you, please do not exist.”
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: “Like a lamp I twist off, when I don't want you, please do not exist.”
achievements.unlockMessage: “Like a lamp I twist off, when I don't want you, please do not exist.” [Discard the maiden and the giant serpent's egg.]

achievements.label: The Chronicle of Little Sister
achievements.descriptionLocked: “She knows, I am writing about her.”
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: “She knows, I am writing about her.”
achievements.unlockMessage: “She knows, I am writing about her.” [Finished writing three diaries.]

achievements.label: The Second Key
achievements.descriptionLocked: Rarely does anyone need two Ligeias to simultaneously turn the keys to open the door; perhaps one after the other, I cannot say.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Rarely does anyone need two Ligeias to simultaneously turn the keys to open the door; perhaps one after the other, I cannot say.
achievements.unlockMessage: Rarely does anyone need two Ligeias to simultaneously turn the keys to open the door; perhaps one after the other, I cannot say. [Obtain the promise of another Ligeia.]

achievements.label: The Fourteenth Shrine
achievements.descriptionLocked: What does the curse of the dead have to do with the living?
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: What does the curse of the dead have to do with the living?
achievements.unlockMessage: What does the curse of the dead have to do with the living? [Discovered the fourteenth shrine beyond the map.]

achievements.label: Healing Master
achievements.unlockMessage: Skills never weigh one down. [Cured “Incurable Snake Venom”]

achievements.label: Many Pebbles, One Beach
achievements.descriptionLocked: Natural selection, survival of the fittest. This is our era.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Natural selection, survival of the fittest. This is our era.
achievements.unlockMessage: Natural selection, survival of the fittest. This is our era. [Kill the remnants of the Seven Coils.]

achievements.label: Boundless Love
achievements.descriptionLocked: You are a distant peace; for you, I must constantly wage war.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: You are a distant peace; for you, I must constantly wage war.
achievements.unlockMessage: You are a distant peace; for you, I must constantly wage war. [Fell in love with the maiden.]

achievements.label: Red Thread Wraps the Finger
achievements.descriptionLocked: “He who gives love receives love; he who bestows blessings will have blessings come to him.”
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: “He who gives love receives love; he who bestows blessings will have blessings come to him.”
achievements.unlockMessage: “He who gives love receives love; he who bestows blessings will have blessings come to him.” [You received a gift from the one you helped.]

achievements.label: No Rest
achievements.descriptionLocked: But I hear the night weeping in my bones. Its thick tears scream madly that something has left forever. One day, we will exist again. — Alejandra Pizarnik, “The Naming of the Night”
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: But I hear the night weeping in my bones. Its thick tears scream madly that something has left forever. One day, we will exist again. — Alejandra Pizarnik, “The Naming of the Night”
achievements.unlockMessage: But I hear the night weeping in my bones. Its thick tears scream madly that something has left forever. One day, we will exist again. — Alejandra Pizarnik, “The Naming of the Night” [Died at the crack in the world's epidermis.]

achievements.label: Spending the Rest of Life: Little Sister
achievements.descriptionLocked: “Humans are not inherently faithful creatures; undying love goes against nature. I swear I will go against my nature, defy my instincts, and love you forever.” — Frank Tallis, “Mad Romance”
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: “Humans are not inherently faithful creatures; undying love goes against nature. I swear I will go against my nature, defy my instincts, and love you forever.” — Frank Tallis, “Mad Romance”
achievements.unlockMessage: “Humans are not inherently faithful creatures; undying love goes against nature. I swear I will go against my nature, defy my instincts, and love you forever.” — Frank Tallis, “Mad Romance” [You survived the Battle of Stalingrad and spent the rest of your life with a non-human maiden.]

achievements.label: The Colonel and the Ant-Mother
achievements.descriptionLocked: “Read as reality, written as fairy tale.”
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: “Read as reality, written as fairy tale.”
achievements.unlockMessage: “Read as reality, written as fairy tale.” [You rose higher together with a maiden during the Battle of Stalingrad.]
